section_summary.extract_value: This section details the 'Attachment to God Inventory (AGI)', an instrument used to assess women's relationship with God. It describes the two subscales, Anxiety and Avoidance, providing example items and interpretation of scores. The section also mentions the AGI's psychometric properties from a previous multi-sample study and reports Cronbach's alpha values for the Anxiety (.87) and Avoidance (.82) subscales in the current study.
